## RE:volution Mod v1.2.12

v1.2.12 packages the accepted project cleanup and runtime fixes after v1.2.11 as the final stable 1.2.x release before the transition to the final 1.3.0 package layout.

### Added
- Added server-resolved `Click Damage` and `Poison Damage` values for accurate combat statistics in the rune GUI.
- Added global combat aggregation across configured rune collections: the selected collection controls viewing/editing, not the player's total combat contribution.
- Added a permanent CI version-consistency check across `build.gradle`, `mcmod.info`, and `CustomGuiMod.VERSION`; release tags are checked against the same metadata.
- Added the current v1.2.12 screenshot set covering the main GUI, enhancement feedback, rune tooltip, large-number modes, and Admin / Test Panel.

### Changed
- Renamed internal Java `Card` / `Deck` / `Earth` terminology to rune/collection terminology where it matches actual responsibilities.
- Extracted independent `admin`, `commands`, `network`, `number`, `resource`, `persistence`, `mob`, and `client.hud` packages without blanket visibility widening.
- Removed the unreachable legacy card-flight path while preserving active purchase and enhancement pulse feedback.
- Rune GUI statistics now render server-resolved click/poison values directly and use the shared Large Numbers formatter.
- Currency and rune-resource values use the shared large-number presentation.
- Removed the old top-screen `Coins | Crystals | Damage` HUD outside the main GUI.
- Separated historical screenshots from the current v1.2.12 presentation set.

### Fixed
- Switching collections no longer triggers false green enhancement pulses on already-enhanced slots.
- Large coin balances are no longer overwritten by the legacy saturated `int` value around `2.15B`.
- Fixed click-damage statistics so the GUI no longer shows the old additive value instead of the resolved rune-combat result.
- Added correct poison-damage statistics and expanded the statistics panel for the extra line.
- Switching to an empty/unconfigured collection no longer disables combat contribution from other configured collections.
- Removed stale overlay values and dark rectangle/mask artifacts behind statistics and the `CURRENCY` heading area.

### Other
- Mongo keys/collections such as `decks`, `cards`, `cardIndex`, `activeDeck`, and `runeEnhancements` remain unchanged.
- Network channel `customgui:main`, discriminator IDs, registration sides/order, command/config payloads, namespace, resource paths, and existing gameplay/economy contracts remain stable except for the explicitly listed runtime fixes.
- Optional-client compatibility for vanilla clients without the mod remains enabled.
- Runtime validation on Test accepted collection switching, global combat contribution, click/poison damage, enhancement/reset behavior, Large Numbers, currency/resource rendering, and removal of the legacy HUD.
- Release metadata is aligned to `1.2.12` and protected by the new CI guard.

### Download
Use the attached `customguimod-1.2.12.jar` on clients that need the custom GUI/rune features and on the server. Clients that do not need those client-side features may connect without `customguimod`.

Compatible resource pack: [RE:volution Resource Pack v1.1.0](https://github.com/Theyyk/re-volution-resource-pack/releases/tag/v1.1.0), available in 64x64 and 128x128 variants.

**Full Changelog:** [v1.2.11...v1.2.12](https://github.com/Theyyk/re-volution-mod/compare/v1.2.11...v1.2.12)
